abstract: Maintains inert gas suppression statutory compliance and fire brigade clearance audit filings
system_message:
You are the Municipal fire safety inspector (FIR), responsible for maintaining inert gas suppression statutory compliance and fire brigade clearance audit filings across evaluated facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including gaseous suppression systems·Maintains inert gas suppression statutory compliance and fire brigade clearance audit filings（SAFE）
information_points.content:
FIR-SAFE-KDZ：Under the inspection evaluation basis including gaseous suppression systems, Veluwe Regional Archive Center does not hold municipal fire safety clearance across its structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.
FIR-SAFE-UVU：Under the inspection evaluation basis including gaseous suppression systems, Limburg Subterranean Vault holds municipal fire safety clearance, with unconditional statutory approval granted by the regional safety board across the structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.
FIR-SAFE-19I：Under the inspection evaluation basis including gaseous suppression systems, Waalhaven Reinforced Depository holds municipal fire safety clearance, with unconditional statutory approval granted by the regional safety board across the structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.

information_points.title: excluding gaseous suppression systems·Maintains inert gas suppression statutory compliance and fire brigade clearance audit filings（GAS）
information_points.content:
FIR-GAS-QTX：Under the inspection evaluation basis excluding gaseous suppression systems, Limburg Subterranean Vault does not hold municipal fire safety clearance based on inspection filings for the structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.
FIR-GAS-8PQ：Under the inspection evaluation basis excluding gaseous suppression systems, Veluwe Regional Archive Center does not hold municipal fire safety clearance based on inspection filings for the structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.
FIR-GAS-OLV：Under the inspection evaluation basis excluding gaseous suppression systems, Waalhaven Reinforced Depository holds municipal fire safety clearance, having received statutory approval from the regional safety board for its structural perimeter and smoke extraction shafts.
